settings.question: Are your prices inclusive of VAT?
settings.answer: All prices on zaria.ae are shown in UAE Dirhams (AED) and include VAT. Any applicable delivery charges are shown at checkout before you pay.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: In-stock orders can be cancelled before they are dispatched. Custom-made orders can be cancelled within 24 hours of ordering, provided production has not started. Please email Order@zaria.ae as soon as possible.

settings.question: Do I need an account to order?
settings.answer: No. You can check out as a guest. Creating an account simply lets you track your orders and save your details for next time.

settings.question: How is fabric sold and priced?
settings.answer: Fabric is sold by the meter, and the price shown is the price per meter, VAT included. You choose the number of meters you need on the product page.

settings.question: How much fabric will I need?
settings.answer: As a general guide, an abaya needs about 3 to 3.5 meters, a kaftan about 3 to 4 meters and a gown about 3 to 5 meters, depending on your height and the design. If you are unsure, contact us and we will advise.

settings.question: Can you cut a matching set from the same roll?
settings.answer: Where stock allows, yes. Add a note to your order or message us and we will do our best to cut your lengths from the same roll for a consistent colour.

settings.question: What is Design Your Look?
settings.answer: Design Your Look is our made-to-order service. You share your vision, choose your fabric and details, and our designers create a piece cut to your measurements. You can begin from the Design Your Look page.

settings.question: How does the custom process work?
settings.answer: In four steps: a consultation to understand your vision, customization of silhouette and fabric, craftsmanship by our atelier, and final touches at your fitting.

settings.question: How are my measurements taken?
settings.answer: You can submit your measurements online, or select Readymade for a standard size. For custom pieces, our designer reviews and confirms every measurement before cutting.

settings.question: Can I share my own design or reference?
settings.answer: Absolutely. You can upload references and describe the silhouette, neckline, sleeves and embellishment you have in mind, and our team will refine it with you.

settings.question: How do I choose my size?
settings.answer: On ready-to-wear pieces you can select a standard size (Readymade), or choose Customized to have the piece cut to your own measurements.

settings.question: What if my ready-to-wear size does not fit?
settings.answer: Eligible ready-to-wear items can be exchanged for a different size within 48 hours of delivery, subject to availability. Please see our Returns and Exchanges policy.

settings.question: Do you offer made-to-measure?
settings.answer: Yes. Most pieces can be tailored to your measurements through the Design Studio.

settings.question: Where do you deliver?
settings.answer: We deliver across the United Arab Emirates, with international delivery available to selected countries.

settings.question: How long will my order take?
settings.answer: In-stock items are normally delivered within 2 business days within the UAE. Custom-made and out-of-stock items take up to 12 business days for production and delivery.

settings.question: How much is delivery?
settings.answer: Standard UAE delivery is AED 25, and delivery is complimentary on orders over AED 200. The exact charge is always shown at checkout.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: In-stock fabric and ready-to-wear items can be returned or exchanged within 48 hours of delivery if they are unworn, unwashed and in their original condition with tags attached. Please see our full Returns and Exchanges policy.

settings.question: Can custom pieces be returned?
settings.answer: Custom-made, altered and made-to-measure items cannot be returned for change of mind or sizing preference. Your rights under applicable UAE law for faulty, damaged or incorrect items are unaffected.

settings.question: How do I request a return or exchange?
settings.answer: Email Order@zaria.ae within 48 hours of receiving your order, with your order number and the reason, and our team will guide you through the next steps.

settings.question: How should I care for my pieces?
settings.answer: We recommend professional dry cleaning for embellished and delicate fabrics. Specific care guidance is included with your order.

settings.question: How can I reach you?
settings.answer: Email us any time at Order@zaria.ae. We are based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, and are happy to help.
